body.plain_text:
Dear students,

After the mid-semester examinations I will run weekly doubt-clearing
sessions for Operating Systems. They are open to everyone in the course
and run for six weeks.

  First session: Wednesday, 28 October 2026
  Time: 17:00-18:00 IST
  Repeats: Every Wednesday for six weeks
  Venue: Room 204, CS Block

Please bring specific questions. The sessions will move through process
scheduling, memory management and file systems, in that order, and the
last session is reserved for revision problems.

A calendar entry for the full series is attached.

Regards,
Prof. Vikram Nair
Department of Computer Science and Engineering
